question: Worker cascade threshold and reach; weighted operator λ_max(A D_q)

metric_definitions.q: q_j = γ_j·P_j(b) on v(0); 0 for zealots
metric_definitions.lambda_ADq: λ_max(A D_q) = λ_max(D_q^½ A D_q^½), whole graph (GPU power iteration)
metric_definitions.lambda_ADq_region: same with q restricted to the target region (= λ_max(A_rr D_q,r))
metric_definitions.naive_kbar_rr_Eq: k̄_rr (mean within-region degree in r) · E_r[q]
metric_definitions.R_obs: Σ_{t≥2} converts_t / Σ_{t≤T−1} converts_t, pooled over the 10 trials (convert → convert branching; each voter spreads for one hop); points with < 20 convert-spreaders dropped
metric_definitions.R_early: converts in hop 2 / converts in hop 1, pooled over the trials (first convert generation)
metric_definitions.R_exp_capped: Σ_{t≥2} Σ_j [1 − (1 − q_j)^{eff_j}] / Σ_{t≥2} spreaders_t, eff_j = min(count_j, cap − attempts_j), q on v at the start of the round (cap-corrected expected branching)
metric_definitions.cap_bind: voters with final attempts = cap / voters with attempts > 0, pooled over trials
metric_definitions.cross_share: distinct converts outside the target region / all distinct converts
metric_definitions.drift_final_P_by_steps: mean final P_j of converted non-worker voters, by social steps since their last conversion (1 = converted in round T); P right after conversion = P(b, b) = 0.971
metric_definitions.delta_expected: expected share with k workers − with 0 workers, same world and θ
metric_definitions.crossing: logistic fit P(R_obs > 1) = σ(a + b log x); x* = exp(−a/b)

cap_binding_vs_threshold.definition: per (world, point, k) pooled cap-binding share, split at λ_max(A D_q) = 1

deviations: Addition to the plan's 9-point sweep: 8 extension points per world on the path b(φ) = (1 − φ)·vertex + φ·b_far (vertex = the simplex vertex of the least-liked sector), chosen so that λ_max(A D_q) ≈ 0.5 … 2.0. The pilot showed the plan sweep never goes below λ_max(A D_q) ≈ 3 (b_far is another region's archetype, liked there), so without them the threshold λ ≈ 1 is not sampled.
Target region = the largest region of each world (the plan says 'one region').
Observed growth: R_obs pools hops 2..T (convert → convert); R_early = converts(hop 2)/converts(hop 1) is reported next to it because depletion and the cap lower later hops.

parity.note: CPU and GPU draw different random numbers (spec §9): metrics compared as means over the seeds, tolerance max(0.01, 3·SE of the paired difference); counts are scaled by N.
